title: Food Allergy Certificate Course
instructors: Dr. Nandana Bala & Dr. Balachandra B.V. and 5+ Faculties
tagline: Practical Clinical Training for Confident Patient Care

paragraphs: The Food Allergy Specialist Program – Essential and Advanced is designed to provide practical clinical training in the recognition, diagnosis and management of food allergy.

The program has two levels: Essentials: For postgraduates in specialties such as Paediatrics, ENT, Pulmonology, General Medicine, Gastroenterology — 12 weeks Advanced: For allergy-trained specialists — 12 weeks + 4 weeks The first 3 months consist of common learning modules, followed by 1 month of advanced training for eligible doctors. The program focuses on the practical clinical application of food allergy management in routine patient care.

The Food Allergy Certificate Course provides practical clinical training in the recognition, diagnosis and management of food allergy. The program covers food hypersensitivity, immunological mechanisms, clinical manifestations, food allergens, diagnostic testing, management, emergency care, gastrointestinal disorders, prevention, oral food challenges, allergen immunotherapy and biologics.

The program focuses on the practical clinical application of food allergy management, including structured history taking, allergy testing, food avoidance and nutritional guidance, anaphylaxis management, prevention strategies, and appropriate use of advanced investigations and therapies.

The Advanced component further covers specialised areas such as non-IgE-mediated allergy, eosinophilic gastrointestinal disorders, component-resolved diagnostics, oral food challenges, allergen immunotherapy and biologics, including case-based learning and practical approaches.

paragraphs: A practical foundation in respiratory allergy for clinicians across specialties.

The course focuses on recognizing respiratory allergy through common clinical presentations, understanding how seemingly different symptoms are connected, and building a strong foundation for further learning in respiratory allergy.

Allergy is often hiding in plain sight. Respiratory allergy often presents through everyday clinical complaints such as sneezing, nasal obstruction, rhinorrhea, chronic cough, wheeze, breathlessness, mouth breathing, and poor asthma control.
The challenge is often not the absence of allergy, but recognizing its presence and understanding how these seemingly different presentations are connected.
This Basic Respiratory Allergy Certificate Course provides a practical foundation in respiratory allergy for clinicians across specialties.

items: Despite completing basic-level allergy training, many doctors hesitate to implement key diagnostic and therapeutic procedures such as Skin Prick Testing, Spirometry, Forced Oscillation Technique (FOT), and Allergen Immunotherapy.

The AAAIC program is designed to bridge this gap by providing hands-on guidance and continuous support, empowering you to confidently integrate allergy and asthma procedures into your clinical practice.
FREE access to 9 months course of Allergy Asthma Specialist Course (AASC) and Guide to Anaphylaxis Preparedness (GAP), and access to the Case Presentation Bank from previous batches.

Internship - An exceptional opportunity to witness the expertise of senior Alumni in managing patients with Allergies and perform Allergy Diagnostics and Therapeutics.

Advanced Allergy Asthma & Immunotherapy is the Next level of Allergy Training taking into consideration the needs of allergy specialists in India, we have developed a 6 months certified course for doctors who have basic qualification such as FAAI, DAA, DPAA, DAAI, Allergy Asthma Specialist Course (AASC) and practising Allergy.

The course has been designed by 18 internationally acclaimed allergists and immunologists from India, the USA, and Singapore, all of whom are affiliated with esteemed institutions such as Harvard University, the University of Colorado, Mount Sinai, the National University of Singapore, Christian Medical College Vellore, and others.

Well-researched information from faculty across the world will help you gain different perspectives and knowledge so that you can upgrade your knowledge and practice the latest recommended evidence-based treatment for this hidden epidemic. With predominantly online recorded sessions, frequent live contact sessions, and 3-days hands-on Personal Contact Session, the AAAIC will also have assignments, Q&A Sessions with the faculty, case presentations and so on to ensure active learning.
This Course focuses mostly on the Diagnostic and Therapeutic Procedures in Allergy practice.
In Diagnostic Procedure - Skin Prick Test, Serological Testing, Component based Diagnostic testing, Spirometry, Forced Oscillation Technique, FeNO, Oral Food Challenge, Oral Drug Challenge, etc.
In Therapeutic Procedure - Sublingual lmmunotherapy, Subcutaneous lmmunotherapy, Biologicals, Anaphylaxis Management etc.

paragraphs: The Executive Certificate in Practice Discoverability is a premium executive education programme developed for consulting doctors, specialists, surgeons, and clinic owners who want to understand how modern patients discover, evaluate, trust, and choose healthcare professionals in today's digital and AI-driven world.

Healthcare has changed significantly over the last decade. While clinical excellence remains the foundation of good medical practice, patients increasingly rely on Google Search, AI assistants, online reviews, healthcare directories, hospital websites, and digital platforms before selecting a doctor. As a result, many highly competent clinicians remain difficult to find despite delivering outstanding patient care.

This programme has been designed to bridge that gap by helping doctors understand how to make their existing clinical excellence visible, trustworthy, and discoverable—without changing their ethical clinical practice.

Participants will learn how patients search for doctors, how trust is established before the first consultation, how Google and AI search systems influence patient decisions, and how to build a strong and credible professional presence across digital platforms.

items: This course provides clinicians with a foundational understanding of the human immune system, emphasizing its relevance to clinical practice. Practical applications, such as immunotherapy, vaccine development, and diagnostic immunological tests, are highlighted to bridge the gap between theory and clinical practice.

By the end of the course, clinicians will be equipped to interpret immune-related diagnostic tests, understand immune-based therapies, and apply immunological principles in the diagnosis and management of a wide range of diseases.

faqs.question: Do I need to follow all or part of the course curriculum guidelines?
paragraphs: It will be mandatory for all the enrolled candidates to follow the course curriculum guidelines completely, failing which either their candidature may be cancelled or they will be not allowed to appear in the exit exam. The decision by CAAP governing body will be final and binding to all in this regard.

faqs.question: What if I can’t attend the PCS sessions after enrollment?
paragraphs: Attendance at the PCS is mandatory for appearing in the final exit exam. If due to certain circumstances, any candidate is unable to attend any PCS, then he/she is supposed to attend the same PCS with the next batch to be eligible for appearing in the final exit exam (next year after completion of all the PCS).

faqs.question: Can PCS session dates change after their announcement?
paragraphs: All sessions are planned as per the availability of faculties, teaching rooms, and other logistics. Once decided, PCS dates will NOT change due to any candidate’s personal request. Dates might change in a rare instance, depending upon the logistics for conducting the sessions. The decision by CAAP governing body will be final and binding to all in this regard. Exit exam - The exit exam will be conducted at the end of the course. Minimum of 60% marks in both theory and practical will be required (independently) for passing the exit exam. Assignments will have predefined weightage in the final exam. The final exam will be evaluated by both Indian & International faculties.

faqs.question: Where will be the PCS held?
paragraphs: The PCS will be held at Bridgetown International University at Barbados

faqs.question: Should I pay a separate fee to write the exam?
paragraphs: There is NO separate exam fee for the candidates enrolled in the same academic batch. If a candidate needs to appear for the exit exam in subsequent batch after enrollment due to any reason (including the inability to attend any PCS or clear the exit exam in scheduled time or others), he/she is supposed to submit the LATE EXIT EXAM FEE (500 USD).

faqs.question: Will I be able to get a refund?
paragraphs: There will be NO refund of any part of the fee after submission, even if the candidate chooses not to join the course or discontinue in between due to any reason. The fee will NOT be transferred to another candidates account if any candidate wishes to do so. In case of any unusual circumstance, the decision of the CAAP governing body will be final and binding to everyone.

faqs.question: Will I get a Cetificate if I join this course?
paragraphs: Successful candidates will be awarded the 'Certificate of Completion of AASC - Caribbean' from Bridgetown University, International Asthma Services, the CAAP program, and MedTrain Academy of Medical Education, along with esteemed seals of endorsement from the Center for Global Health, University of Colorado, USA, and the American Academy of Allergy, Asthma, and Immunology.

faqs.question: Will I get a dispute settlement?
paragraphs: Dispute settlement - The venue of the arbitration will be independent countries of Caribbean Common Law system will be applicable. The Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic court alone will have the exclusive jurisdiction to adjudication in case of any dispute.
